## Summary

What this changes and why, in a few lines. Link the ADR or issue if there is one.

## Changed files

List them, or group them by crate. Say which crate owns the change.

## Decisions and tradeoffs

What was chosen, what was rejected, and why. Name any ADR this touches, and if it conflicts with one, say which and why it is being reopened.

## Commands and exact results

Paste the commands you ran and their pass or fail results. "Tests pass" is not a result: give the recipe (`just test-pkg <crate>`, `just e2e-p9`, `just lint`) and what it printed, or the CI job and its outcome.

A change is complete when it compiles, is wired and is exercised. A compile alone is not completion. If a proof only runs on macOS, say which CI job ran it and that it ran, not skipped.

## Remaining blockers

The exact missing prerequisite for each, or "none".

## Intentionally skipped

Work you chose not to do here, and where it is tracked, or "none".

## Remaining risks

What could still be wrong after this merges, or "none".
